prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: neck and back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1112; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed first notice of loss. Insured reports vehicle was turning left at an intersection when it was struck by a vehicle traveling straight through on the cross street. Insured states the other driver ran a late yellow light. Police report requested. No citations confirmed at this time.

Entry 2: Spoke with insured by phone. Insured confirms no prior claims involving this vehicle in the last several years. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file. Damage to the driver's side of insured vehicle appears consistent with the reported angle of impact. Rental coverage verified under policy.

Entry 3: Claimant has retained counsel. Attorney letter of representation received requesting that all communication be directed to their office. Claimant's injury described as neck and back strain. Medical authorization forms sent to attorney. Recorded statements from claimant to be arranged only through counsel.

Entry 4: Received police report. Officer documented the other driver as cited for failure to obey a traffic control device. Liability assessment updated to reflect primary fault on the other driver, with possible comparative consideration regarding the insured's left turn timing. Statement from independent witness requested through records.

Entry 5: Attorney's office submitted initial treatment records showing evaluation for neck and back strain with a recommended course of physical therapy. Demand package not yet received. Reserve reviewed and maintained pending medical documentation. File flagged for follow-up with counsel on outstanding records and scheduled review.
